summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Global X S&P 500 Quality Dividend ETF (QDIV) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 Quality High Dividend index. The fund tracks an index of equal-weighted US large-cap stocks selected from the S&P 500 Index based on quality and dividend metrics. QDIV was launched on Jul 13, 2018 and is issued by Global X.

holdings.infoBox: QDIV is an equity ETF with a total of 52 individual holdings. The top holdings are Gilead Sciences stock at 2.45%, Becton, Dickinson and Company at 2.43%, Target at 2.42%, Best Buy Co. at 2.32%, and International Flavors & Fragrances at 2.25%.
